sloka: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रो महाकपिम् ।वायुपुत्रं महावीर्यं वहन्तं राघवं रणे ।आजघान शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः कालानलशिखोपमैः ।। ६.५९.१३५ ।।।।
transliteration: rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā rākṣasendro mahākapim ।vāyuputraṁ mahāvīryaṁ vahantaṁ rāghavaṁ raṇe ।ājaghāna śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ kālānalaśikhopamaiḥ ।। 6.59.135 ।।।।

translations.english: On hearing Raghava's words, the mighty strong king of Rakshasas seized with violent anger, recalling earlier enmity, struck with blazing arrows like tongues of fire at the time of universal destruction while Hanuman bore Rama.
